description: This Java source file defines the class PolicyQuerySignalMapper which extends AbstractQuerySignalMapper for handling PolicyQueryCommand objects related to policy queries within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter. It provides an implementation for constructing the topic path for policy query signals.

classes.name: PolicyQuerySignalMapper
classes.description: A specialized signal mapper for PolicyQueryCommand objects, responsible for generating the appropriate topic path for policy query signals in the protocol adapter context.

methods.name: getTopicPathBuilder
methods.description: Overrides the method to return a TopicPathBuilder instance configured for policy queries based on the entity ID within the command.
